summary: Executed requested auth+R2 regressions, added forgot/reset password regression, built frontend, and ran Playwright smoke on preview and production domains.

ui_bugs.issue: Production www domain does not show Google buttons and does not expose new callback/reset behavior testids seen in preview.

integration_issues.issue: Preview domain has new auth implementation, but production www appears to still serve older auth pages/routes.

action_items: Deploy/sync preview auth frontend bundle to production www/apex so Google buttons and callback/reset flows match tested implementation.
Post-deploy, rerun production smoke for /login, /register, /reset-password?token=..., and /#session_id=invalid-session-id.
Optional hardening: remove default fallback FRONTEND_URL in backend/email_service.py to enforce fail-fast env config in all environments.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth + R2 logic is aligned with requested behavior: single-use Google session exchange (409 replay), trusted same-origin link origin checks, credentialed explicit CORS, and merge-safe R2 CORS preservation.
email_service.py still contains a hardcoded FRONTEND_URL default preview domain fallback; this can generate wrong links when env is missing and weakens fail-fast config policy.

success_rate.frontend: Preview 100% for requested auth smoke; Production www failed parity checks

seed_data_creation: Temporary users/labels/reset tokens created in pytest and cleaned up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest command run: test_phase52_google_auth_and_r2_cors + test_iter34_auth_playbook_public + test_phase41_multidevice_auth + iter42 forgot/reset regression. Frontend build succeeded. Preview URL validates new auth UI behavior; production www still appears on old auth build/routing.
rca of the issue: RCA (current evidence): implementation is present and working on preview but not reflected on production www frontend bundle/routes. Reproduction: open https://www.rilismusik.com/login and /register; Google buttons testids absent. Open /reset-password?token=abc: token input still visible; open /#session_id=invalid-session-id: callback component absent. Mitigation: ensure production frontend deployment targets www/apex, then rerun smoke against production domain.
